title: Portrait workshop
heading: Prepare a usable portrait
description: A small example of authored content generated through a shared shell.
body:
Review before publishing. Choose an evenly lit portrait with a clear outline and room above the subject. A simple crop helps a reader compare practical choices without relying on a decorative background.

Use the portrait checklist to inspect framing and avoid ambiguous edges. These example paragraphs illustrate the generator; write distinct, accurate content for a real site.

title: Portrait checklist
heading: Check the edges before exporting
description: A second authored example with different content and the same navigation.
body:
Review before publishing. Inspect the whole head, shoulders, and any object crossing the subject. Reflections and deep shadows can conceal the details that matter. If a crop removes an ear or cuts through a hand, start with a clearer source.

Return to the workshop home when the photo is ready. A shared shell keeps navigation consistent while the substance of each page remains independently written.
